notes.title: Casual Desires— Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! We're getting closer to the Steam launch of Casual Desires, which is expected between November to January.[/p][p]The launch will include 21 Chapters of content (~10-15 hours of gameplay), representing about 80% of the full game. The Early Access period will last for roughly a year until the 1.0 release.[/p][p]Don't forget to [b]wishlist Casual Desires[/b] so you'll be notified at launch![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45314603/e3d16577f135db1bc7a9e60c1c9d3a29a0cfc369.png"][/img][/p][p]If you enjoy adult stories, you might also like my other game— [b]Rebel Duet[/b].[/p][p]Rebel Duet offers a darker, more story-driven experience, while still sharing many similarities with Casual Desires in character design and sexual content. Right now it's [b]25% off[/b] for the next two weeks!

  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676930/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
